input: I haven't been in the city long, so everything still feels a bit strange. Back where I come from I used to work with plants. Herbs, mostly.
draft:
Jessa Rook sets down the cloth she was using to wipe the timber counter, leaning lightly against it with her forearms bare. Her gaze measures you with quiet, professional calm, neither prying nor dismissive.

"Plenty of folk coming into West are trying to find their footing," Jessa says, her voice low and steady. "It’s a dense district. Workshops and warehouses on one corner, families and tradesmen on the next. Takes some getting used to if you're accustomed to quieter ground."

She glances toward your hands, then back up to your face. "Herbs are practical enough work. People here always have aches, bad water, or dirty cuts needing tending, though you'll find most trades around these streets keep their own arrangements. If you're looking to turn your hand to it here, you'll want to keep your eyes open and see how the market runs before putting coin into stock."
